visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with brown hair and bangs sits in a bright indoor room. She holds two large instant noodle bowls towards the camera. The bowl lids feature anime-style artwork. She wears a white graphic t-shirt. The background is a simple, neutral-colored wall with soft lighting. (2) The camera zooms in on one bowl titled 'Galaxy Squid Ink Dry Noodle.' An animation clip from a cooking anime appears as an overlay, showing a cosmic bowl of noodles. She points at the anime-style character on the packaging lid. (3) The woman opens the lid, revealing several seasoning packets. One is a red 'Seafood Seasoning' pouch with gold text. She then holds up a transparent packet of wet noodles. The camera angle is eye-level and close-up. (4) A close-up shot shows the bowl filled with white noodles. A dark, thick black liquid is poured from a packet over the noodles. The sauce is glossy and black. She then shows a second bowl with reddish-brown broth and wide noodles. (5) The woman uses black chopsticks to lift a large portion of the black noodles and a small squid ring. She takes a bite and chews. Her eyebrows furrow, and she looks skeptical and unimpressed. She points to the noodles with her chopsticks. (6) Large red and yellow variety text overlays appear on the screen. She points her finger at the camera while holding the noodle bowl. Two circular stamps with Chinese characters meaning 'Bad Taste' appear on top of her head in the video.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A cheerful, high-tempo pop track with a strong drum beat and electronic synthesizer melodies plays in the background. A female voice speaks with high energy and a friendly tone, introducing themed instant noodles. The recording is studio-clean with no ambient noise. (2) The sound of a plastic packet being rustled is clearly audible as the speaker handles the seasoning pouches. Her speech rate is fast and conversational. The background music maintains its upbeat rhythm. A light 'ding' sound effect occurs when text appears on screen. (3) A distinct liquid pouring sound—a viscous 'glug'—is heard as she empties the sauce packet into the bowl. This is followed by a sharp 'click' sound as she taps the bowl. The background music ducks slightly under her voice. (4) A loud slurping sound occurs as she takes a bite of the noodles. The music continues, but her vocal tone shifts from enthusiastic to critical and slightly annoyed. Her speech becomes more emphasized and slower to convey genuine disappointment. (5) A metallic 'stamp' sound effect triggers as graphical stamps appear on screen. The speaker raises her volume and uses a sarcastic, humorous tone to conclude the review. The music fades out slightly toward the end of the clip as she finishes her critique.
